title: System prompt and respond_with teach wrong blocker declaration format
description:
The system prompt (`puppeteer/prompts/default.md:58`) and the `respond_with` hints from `pass_priority` teach the object format for blocker declarations:

```
blockers=[{"id":"p5","blocks":"p1"},{"id":"p6","blocks":"p2"}]
```

But `ChooseActionTool.java:78` declares the `blockers` parameter as `String[]` with description:

```
Array of "blocker_id:attacker_id" strings. Example: ["p5:p1","p6:p2"]
```

When models follow the system prompt (which they see first and trust most), the MCP parameter deserializer fails because it can't convert JSON objects to strings:

```
Parameter 'blockers': expected array of strings, got JsonArray ([{"id":"p41","blocks":"p14"}])
```

Models self-correct after the error, but this wastes a round-trip and tokens every time.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260228_010846_g4/Gem25F Lucky_errors.log: blocker format error
- puppeteer/prompts/default.md:58 — teaches object format
- puppeteer/tests/golden/exports/savannah_lions_trade.json:1668 — respond_with also teaches object format
- ChooseActionTool.java:78 — tool expects String[] with "id:blocks" format

Fix options:
1. Update default.md and the respond_with builder to teach the string format `["p5:p1"]`
2. Or accept both formats in the tool by parsing objects from the JsonArray before converting to String[]
